texts.title_text: Massachusetts jury deadlocked in Lindsay Clancy murder case
texts.slide_1_text: Judge declares mistrial after jurors deadlocked on Clancy's guilt, ending a five-week trial
texts.slide_2_text: Defense claimed Clancy suffered from bipolar disorder and postpartum psychosis, arguing she wasn't criminally responsible
texts.slide_3_text: Prosecutors maintained she planned the killings and attempted suicide, citing premeditation
texts.slide_4_text: Next hearing set for Sept. 29 as legal battle over mental health and criminal responsibility continues
